Class AdminService

java.lang.Object
com.bupt.ta.service.AdminService
public class AdminService extends Object
Administrator widgets that expose TA utilization, departmental drill-down helpers, aggregated workload dashboards, and lightweight user maintenance hooks for the `/admin/**` controllers.

buildTAWorkloads(String) derives each TA row from ACTIVE WorkloadRecord rows grouped by tutor id. Per-assignment monetisation multiples weekly hours by a fixed demo factor of eight to approximate one semester workload.

    • calculateTAWorkloads

      public List<Map<String,Object>> calculateTAWorkloads(String semester, String keyword, String departmentFilter)
      Primary workload grid builder respecting optional semester narrowing plus UI filters supplied from JSP widgets.
      Parameters:
      semester - optional textual semester filter (ignored when null)
      keyword - case-insensitive match against TA name, student id or email substring
      departmentFilter - exact departmental label match against TA or vacancy metadata
      Returns:
      immutable table rows keyed by descriptive strings (taId, assignedVacancies, utilizationPct, etc.)
